digest.en: Houthi strikes on Riyadh airport and a Russian blueprint for a dark winter in Ukraine define the immediate security picture. Meanwhile, Paramount and Warner Bros merge under Skydance to reshape Hollywood’s corporate structure.
digest.hi: ओडिशा के कोलकाता अस्पताल के पास एक एंबुलेंस में ऑक्सीजन सिलेंडर फटने से मरीज की मौत और दो कर्मियों को गंभीर जलन हुई।

articles.title: Kurdish PKK group says Turkish state not doing enough to pursue peace process
articles.summary: The Kurdish PKK announced it withdrew all armed forces near the Turkish border. The group stated this move prevents the government from making excuses. They accused Ankara of taking an inadequate approach to the ongoing peace process. “We have withdrawn all our armed forces, both within and outside of Turkiye, that could be considered near the border,” the PKK said, adding that the move was taken to prevent the government “making any excuses or justifying its inadequate approach to the process”.

articles.title: Seychelles giant tortoise numbers hit record 180,000 in conservation triumph
articles.summary: The Aldabra giant tortoise population on the Seychelles atoll reached a record 180,000. Decades of conservation efforts allowed the once endangered species to thrive. The free-roaming herd now numbers higher than at any previous point in recorded history. Free-roaming Aldabra population thrives on Indian Ocean atoll due to decades-long recovery programmeA survey of the world’s largest free-roaming giant tortoise population has discovered that the once endangered species is thriving. A population of Aldabra giant tortoises lives on an island in Seychelles called Aldabra Atoll.

articles.title: "Shinzo Abe Had Many Plans For World": Wife Breaks Down At NDTV Summit
articles.summary: Akie Abe spoke at an NDTV summit about her husband, former Prime Minister Shinzo Abe. She recalled the morning of his assassination in Nara. She described him as being in a good mood before he left for his political event. Reminiscing about July 8, the day the former Japanese PM was shot dead during a political event in the nation's Nara, Abe said he was in a very good mood and had breakfast with her and his mother.

articles.title: 'Key Targets': A Russian Blueprint For A Cold, Dark Winter In Ukraine
articles.summary: A Russian document outlines a plan to cut power, heat, and water supplies in Ukraine. The strategy aims to inflict severe suffering on civilians during the upcoming winter. This marks the fifth winter of the full-scale invasion. As Ukraine prepares for its fifth winter since the start of Russia’s full-scale invasion, a document obtained by RFE/RL sets out a potential blueprint for a campaign by Moscow to inflict enormous suffering on civilians with attacks aimed at sharply cutting supplies of power, heat, and water.

articles.title: Japanese Odissi Dancer, Indian Entrepreneur On Feeling Of Belongingness
articles.summary: Japanese Odissi dancer Naka discussed her journey in an interview. She initially doubted her ability to express Abhinaya due to her ethnicity. She has since accepted her identity and considers the dance form central to her life. Naka said Odissi is her life. She also spoke about her early doubts. "I'm Japanese, and my eyes are too small to express Abhinaya," she said.

articles.title: ‘Age must never diminish rights,’ UN independent expert warns
articles.summary: A UN independent expert warned that older women face violence and neglect while remaining invisible in protective laws and policies. The report highlighted how existing frameworks fail to address the specific vulnerabilities of aging women globally. Older women around the world face violence, exploitation and neglect, yet remain largely invisible in the laws, policies, data and services designed to protect women overall, a UN independent human rights expert said on Thursday.

articles.title: Poverty deepens as families face multiple shocks with limited resources
articles.summary: The UN Development Programme reported that Myanmar is experiencing a simultaneous collapse of shelter, healthcare, and livelihoods. Years of conflict, displacement, and climate shocks have deepened poverty for millions of families with limited resources. Years of conflict, displacement, economic disruption and climate shocks in Myanmar have led to the “simultaneous collapse” of shelter, healthcare, schooling and livelihoods affecting millions of people, the UN Development Programme (UNDP) said in a report issued on Thursday.

articles.title: Paramount and Warner Bros merge to become one Hollywood giant, Skydance
articles.summary: Paramount and Warner Bros merged under David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz. The deal unites two historic studios. It concentrates media power further. The industry already operates with few major players. This consolidation reshapes Hollywood's competitive structure. The merger brings two of America's oldest moviemaking studios together under the helm of billionaire David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz, in a move that is projected to concentrate power in an industry already run by just a handful of major players.

articles.title: Yemen’s Houthis say struck Riyadh airport, other Saudi sites
articles.summary: Yemen's Houthis claimed strikes on Riyadh airport and other Saudi sites. The UN reports over 184,000 people displaced. The conflict has become the region's most active front. Fighting continues to deepen across West Asia. The fighting in Yemen has become the most active front in the West Asia war in recent weeks, displacing more than 1,84,000 people, the United Nations says, and deepening the conflict that has engulfed the wider region.

articles.title: India’s Central Asia missile sales spark a new Great Game
articles.summary: India exported Akash missile systems to Tajikistan and Turkmenistan. Defense Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh confirmed the deals. Central Asian states seek alternative suppliers. This move counters Russia's waning dominance. It also addresses Sino-Indian rivalry. A flurry of landmark arms deals is reshaping Central Asia’s strategic landscape, as regional states leverage alternative defense suppliers to assert their sovereignty amid Russia’s waning dominance and an intensifying Sino-Indian rivalry.

articles.title: Bit by bit, the Taliban is losing control of Afghanistan
articles.summary: Armed resistance in Afghanistan is spreading beyond isolated pockets, challenging the Taliban's claim of stable governance. Five years after taking Kabul, the group still controls all provincial capitals. However, the growing geographic dispersion of insurgent groups undermines their argument for international acceptance. Five years after seizing Kabul, the Taliban’s strongest argument for international acceptance rests on control. The Taliban governs every provincial capital and faces no conventional army capable of marching on Kabul.

articles.title: Exiled Russian Activist Describes How Kremlin Targets Critics Abroad
articles.summary: Mikhail Klimaryov, a Russian activist living in Germany, says Kremlin agents continue to target him abroad. The persistent pressure has driven him into a state of paranoia regarding his personal safety. He fled Russia to escape political persecution but remains under constant surveillance. Mikhail Klimaryov fled Russia to escape political persecution and now lives in Germany, but says he is still not safe.

articles.title: World's largest penguin colony shrinks two-thirds in just 14 years
articles.summary: The world's largest penguin colony has shrunk by nearly two-thirds in fourteen years. A new study identifies climate change as a primary driver of this rapid population decline. The finding highlights the accelerating impact of environmental shifts on Antarctic wildlife populations. The population of a penguin colony that was previously the largest in the world has fallen by almost two-thirds, a new study has revealed - with climate change thought to be a major reason for the decline.

articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro’s advance in Brazil’s election is grim jolt for climate campaigners
articles.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro’s election lead threatens Amazon conservation efforts. Climate campaigners warn of increased deforestation and ecosystem collapse. President Lula’s success in curbing deforestation failed to translate into electoral support. The rainforest faces a critical four-year period. Inquest under way into why President Lula’s success in curbing Amazon deforestation has not lead to success at pollsMore fire, more ash, more crime, more death.

articles.title: Sanctioned Belarus Trucks And A Mystery Logo: 'HAL' Vehicles Spotted In Minsk
articles.summary: Trucks bearing the unknown "HAL" logo have appeared in Minsk. The vehicles likely originate from the sanctioned Minsk Automobile Plant, reflecting deepening trade ties between Belarus and Indonesia despite Western restrictions on the manufacturer. Belarus’s Minsk Automobile Plant is under Western sanctions, limiting who can buy the vehicles produced there. That may be the reason trucks branded with the previously unknown “HAL” badge have been spotted amid strengthening trade relations between Belarus and Indonesia.

articles.title: Fears grow as Flávio Bolsonaro vows to ‘re-democratise’ Brazil
articles.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro vowed to re-democratise Brazil after winning the first round. Critics fear he will continue his father’s authoritarian rule. The son of the disgraced ex-president leads the race. His victory signals the rapid rise of the Bolsonaro political house. After a surprise first-round victory, critics suggest son of disgraced ex-president could seek to continue his father’s authoritarian ruleFlávio’s surprise first-round win highlights rapid rise of Brazil’s House of BolsonaroFlávio Bolsonaro, the far-right frontrunner to become Brazil’s next president, has vowed to “re-democratise” the South American country, fuelling fears over a move into authori.

articles.title: Kenya races to trace all contacts after first Ebola death, WHO official says
articles.summary: Kenya is tracing all contacts of its first Ebola death case. The World Health Organization’s top official in the country confirmed that the United Nations and partners are providing full support for the rapid response effort. Kenya’s first Ebola death has triggered a race to trace everyone the victim came into contact with, as the United Nations and partners provide full support, the World Health Organization’s (WHO) top official in the country has told UN News in her first interview on the case.

articles.title: Massive Russian Attack Kills At Least 22, Devastates Pryluky Apartment Block
articles.summary: Russia launched a massive overnight missile and drone attack on Ukraine. At least 19 people died in the strikes. A five-story apartment block in Pryluky was severely damaged. Homes and infrastructure in Kremenchuk also suffered extensive destruction. Russia launched a massive overnight missile and drone attack across Ukraine, killing at least 19 people. Strikes severely damaged a 5-story apartment building in the northeastern city of Pryluky and caused extensive damage to homes and infrastructure in Kremenchuk in the central Poltava region.

articles.title: Oil Tanker Hit By Naval Drones Near Sochi, Sparking Massive Fire On Black Sea
articles.summary: A Liberian-flagged tanker caught fire off Sochi after a drone attack on October 6. All 23 Indian crew members were rescued. Ukrainian monitors identified the vessel as part of Russia’s shadow fleet. The incident highlights growing risks to commercial shipping in the Black Sea. A Liberian-flagged oil tanker caught fire off the Russian resort city of Sochi after an apparent drone attack, Russian authorities said on October 6.

articles.title: US-Australia hypersonic push no silver bullet against China
articles.summary: The US and Australia conducted an inaugural hypersonic weapon flight test over an Australian range. The exercise demonstrates a joint push for standoff strike capabilities. However, the weapon’s combat value depends on whether allied airbases can survive China’s long-range fires. The inaugural flight-test release of a US air-launched hypersonic weapon over an Australian weapons range demonstrates both nations’ push for standoff hypersonic strike, yet the weapon’s true combat value hinges on whether allied airbases and kill chains can survive China’s long-range fires.

articles.title: When Asia’s central banks turn bond vigilante on Trump
articles.summary: Asian central banks may stop buying US Treasuries due to Trump's trade policies. Japan and China have historically been major creditors. Their potential withdrawal would strain Washington's debt financing. Geopolitical tensions are forcing a reassessment of long-standing financial commitments. TOKYO – For decades, the US enjoyed a remarkable luxury: its two biggest creditors, Japan and China, kept showing up at Treasury auctions with checkbooks open.

articles.title: How China deploys wartime history against Japan
articles.summary: Xi Jinping used his Washington visit to undermine US-Japan relations. He deployed wartime history to challenge Tokyo's security posture. Japanese leaders arranged a brief UN meeting to counter this. The strategic goal was to weaken the American alliance with Japan. Beyond all the pageantry, the Chinese leader Xi Jinping had a strategic goal for his Washington visit – to undermine the American relationship with Japan.

articles.title: Kenya confirms first Ebola case as virus ‘surges’ in DR Congo province
articles.summary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola death after a citizen arrived from the DRC. Health officials identified twenty-eight close contacts for monitoring. The virus continues to spread rapidly in the DRC's north-east. This marks the seventeenth known outbreak of the disease in the region. Health minister says 28 contacts identified after death of citizen who arrived from DRC on SaturdayKenya has reported its first-ever Ebola death, the health minister announced on Tuesday, as the disease continues to spread rapidly through the north-east of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where the outbreak was announced in May. This is the 17th outbreak of the highly infectious, often deadl.

articles.title: From drought to deluge: ‘Super’ El Niño’s expanding reach
articles.summary: Papua New Guinea faces drying water sources and failing crops. Food prices are rising months before peak agricultural damage. Pacific Ocean temperatures have surpassed records from 1997 and 2015. Experts are labeling this pattern a Super El Niño. Across Papua New Guinea, water sources are drying up, crops are failing and food prices are rising months before the worst agricultural impacts are expected.

articles.title: Tigray rebel groups ‘forcibly recruiting boys as young as 15’ as fighting spreads
articles.summary: A new Tigray rebel alliance is forcibly recruiting boys as young as fifteen. Fighting resumed on 23 September, threatening a fresh humanitarian crisis in northern Ethiopia. Civilians are fleeing as armed groups round up men and boys on the streets. Civilians try to flee as men and boys rounded up on streets by new alliance as Ethiopia conflict erupts againAs renewed fighting has threatened a fresh humanitarian crisis in the northern region of Ethiopia, reports are emerging that a new alliance of armed groups in Tigray has been forcibly recruiting men and boys to its ranks. Renewed conflict erupted on 23 September between Ethiopia’s federal go.

articles.title: 'गिफ्तारी के नियम हटने का स्वागत', GST रिफॉर्म पर बोले PM मोदी- इससे बढ़ेगी पारदर्शिता
articles.summary: जीएसटी काउंसिल ने टैक्स अधिकारियों की गिरफ्तारी के अधिकार को समाप्त किया। साथ ही अभियोजन सीमा एक करोड़ से पाँच करोड़ रुपये तक बढ़ाई गई। प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने इस निर्णय की सराहना करते हुए पारदर्शिता बढ़ने का दावा किया। जीएसटी काउंसिल की 57वीं बैठक में लिए फैसले की प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने तारीफ की है. इस बैठक के तहत GST टैक्‍स अधिकारियों के पास से गिरफ्तारी करने के अधिकार को समाप्‍त करने को मंजूरी दी गई.

articles.summary: एलन मस्क ने एक्स पर अंबानी के स्टारलिंक विवाद पर टिप्पणी की। राहुल गांधी ने उन्हें भारत में स्वागत करते हुए दूसरे व्यक्ति के बारे में इंतजार करने की सलाह दी। मस्क ने इस प्रतिक्रिया पर चिंता जताते हुए धन्यवाद दिया। दुनिया के सबसे अमीर शख्स एलन मस्क ने एक्स पर पोस्ट किया है. इस पर अब नेता प्रतिपक्ष राहुल गांधी ने कहा है कि एलन, भारत में आपका स्वागत है.

articles.summary: न्यूयॉर्क टाइम्स ने दावा किया कि पाकिस्तान ने यमन में हूतियों पर एयरस्ट्राइक की। इसके बाद हूतियों ने रियाध एयरपोर्ट पर बैलिस्टिक मिसाइल से हमला किया। डर के मारे पाकिस्तानी सूचना मंत्रालय ने रिपोर्ट को झूठा बताकर खारिज कर दिया। मक्का समझौते के तहत सऊदी अरब में 8,000 सैनिक और फाइटर जेट्स भेजकर पाकिस्तान खुद फंस गया है. न्यूयॉर्क टाइम्स ने दावा किया था कि पाकिस्तानी वायुसेना ने यमन में हूतियों पर एयरस्ट्राइक की है.

articles.title: 8 लोगों के हत्यारे सोनिया-संजीव की रिहाई पर SC ने फैसला रखा सुरक्षित रखा, जानें क्या कहा?
articles.summary: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने सोनिया और संजीव की रिहाई के मामले में फैसला सुरक्षित रखा। जस्टिस दीपांकर दत्ता ने कहा कि अदालतों का दयालु रवैया हत्या के दोषियों को बार-बार राहत दे रहा है। उन्होंने माफ करने की भी सीमा होनी चाहिए, यह टिप्पणी की। सुप्रीम कोर्ट के जस्टिस दीपांकर दत्ता ने कहा है कि अदालतों के दयालु रवैये के चलते हत्या के दोषी बार-बार राहत पा रहे हैं.

articles.title: जिस क्यूबा ने अमेरिका को चुनौती दी, आज फिर ट्रंप के दबाव में क्यों है?

articles.summary: एयर इंडिया एक्सप्रेस ने रियाद जाने वाली सभी उड़ानें 10 अक्टूबर तक रद्द कर दी हैं। मौजूदा हालात के कारण यह फैसला लिया गया है। प्रभावित यात्रियों को पूरा रिफंड दिया जाएगा। उन्हें मुफ्त में नई उड़ान बुक करने का विकल्प भी मिलेगा। रियाद के मौजूदा हालात को देखते हुए एयर इंडिया एक्‍सप्रेस ने वहां जाने वाली अपनी सभी फ्लाइट्स को 10 अक्‍टूबर तक के लिए कैंसिल कर दिया है.

articles.title: ‘TVK में BJP नाम लेने की...’, तमिलनाडु की विजय सरकार पर DMK का प्रहार
articles.summary: डीएमके ने तमिलनाडु की विजय सरकार पर टीवीके पर निशाना साधा है। टीवीके ने राहुल गांधी की पुलिस हिरासत के बाद बीजेपी का नाम नहीं लिया। डीएमके ने सवाल उठाया कि टीवीके को बीजेपी का नाम लेने में क्या डर है। लोकसभा में नेता विपक्ष राहुल गांधी की पुलिस हिरासत को लेकर BJP का नाम न लेने पर DMK ने तमिलनाडु के मुख्यमंत्री सी.

articles.title: बलूच परिवारों का बड़ा आरोप – ‘पाकिस्तानी सेना की वजह से बलूचिस्तान में बढ़ी अपहरण की घटनाएं’
articles.summary: बलूचिस्तान में अपहरण की घटनाओं में इजाफा हुआ है। बलूच परिवारों ने पाकिस्तानी सेना को इसका कारण बताया। खुजदार जिले में 32 वर्षीय ड्राइवर मुनीर अहमद को घर से अगवाया गया। हथियारबंद लोगों ने 2 अक्टूबर की रात यह कार्रवाई की। बलूचिस्तान (Balochistan) की मीडिया रिपोर्ट के अनुसार प्रांत में अपहरण की घटनाओं में इजाफा देखने को मिला है। ज़बरदस्ती लोगों को अगवा किया जा रहा है।

articles.title: 'मुक्के मारे, लात मारी', कांग्रेस के विरोध-प्रदर्शन के दौरान दिल्ली पुलिस के कॉन्स्टेबल की आपबीती
articles.summary: दिल्ली पुलिस ने कांग्रेस के विरोध प्रदर्शन के दौरान जवानों पर धक्का-मुक्की और हमले का आरोप लगाया। पुलिस का दावा है कि कानून-व्यवस्था बनाए रखने की कोशिश के दौरान ही यह घटना हुई। मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त (CEC) ज्ञानेश कुमार के खिलाफ विपक्ष के विरोध प्रदर्शन के दौरान दिल्ली पुलिस के जवानों ने हाथापाई और मारपीट के आरोप लगाए हैं. पुलिस अधिकारियों का कहना है कि जब वे कानून-व्यवस्था बनाए रखने और सुरक्षा पाबंदियों को लागू करने की कोशिश कर रहे थे, तब उनके साथ धक्का-मुक्की की गई और उन पर हमला हुआ.

articles.title: पंजाब के 50 वार्डों के चुनाव SC ने किए रद्द, अब HC की निगरानी में होगी प्रक्रिया
articles.summary: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने पंजाब के पटियाला और मोगा जिलों के 50 नगर निगम वार्डों के चुनाव रद्द कर दिए। कोर्ट ने 6 सप्ताह के भीतर नए चुनाव कराने का निर्देश दिया है। पंजाब के पटियाला और मोगा जिलों के 50 नगर निगम वार्डों के चुनावों को सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने रद्द कर दिया है. कोर्ट का यह कड़ा फैसला उस जांच रिपोर्ट के बाद आया है, जिसमें चुनाव प्रक्रिया के दौरान भारी धांधली, हिंसा और प्रत्याशियों को पर्चा भरने से रोकने के सनसनीखेज खुलासे हुए हैं.

articles.summary: हूती विद्रोहियों ने सऊदी अरब के किंग खालिद इंटरनेशनल एयरपोर्ट पर बैलिस्टिक मिसाइल से हमला किया। एयरपोर्ट पर धमाके की खबर के बाद सभी उड़ानें रोक दी गईं। हूती विद्रोहियों ने किंग खालिद इंटरनेशनल एयरपोर्ट पर घातक बैलिस्टिक मिसाइल से हमला किया है. गुरुवार दोपहर हुए इस भीषण धमाके के बाद एयरपोर्ट पर धुएं का गुबार देखा गया और एहतियात के तौर पर सभी उड़ानों को रोककर रेड अलर्ट जारी कर दिया गया है.

articles.title: क्या सीजेपी AAP की बी-टीम? पंजाब के CM भगवंत मान ने दिया जवाब
articles.summary: पंजाब के मुख्यमंत्री भगवंत मान ने आम आदमी पार्टी को देश की ए टीम बताया। उन्होंने सीजेपी को पार्टी की बी टीम कहने वाले दावों को खारिज कर दिया। सीजेपी आम आदमी पार्टी की बी टीम है. इन दावों पर पंजाब के मुख्यमंत्री भगवंत मान ने कहा है कि आप देश के 140 करोड़ लोगों और पंजाब के 3.5 करोड़ लोगों की A टीम है.
